All ten candidates inspected at a 96-pixel profile-card crop. C03 and C07 have the strongest small-size silhouette; C05 is lowest contrast.
Dimensions, byte sizes, and SHA-256 hashes recorded for every candidate.

score.notes: Historical maker execution score only. It failed to measure whether the study explored the correct design variable, and is superseded by founder rejection. A high craft score cannot rescue the wrong experiment.

known_risks: The experiment locked the key variable Frank wanted to explore: morphology, scale, proportion, locomotion, and embodiment.
Style transfer may drift the exact panel geometry or eye shape.
Print and craft simulation can become nostalgic decoration instead of operational trust.
One master crop cannot prove every web and marketplace placement.
The current SIS night-lab visual file conflicts with the newer foundation-reset civic intelligence territory; the newer dated reset governs this study.
